notes.title: Update V0.04
notes.notes:
Changelog:

Major graphics overhaul 

Major performance optimization 

Adjusted the default graphical settings

Fixed few memory leaks

Fixed lights & shadows flickering

Added key binds to skip forward/backward 30 minutes in time ("F9" & "F11")

Street lights turn on earlier than sunset for better visibility

Created a dev/cheat menu using the button (~) 

Fixed engine animations

Fixed cars being squatted/lifted in the dealer

Fixed major physics bug in the suspension causing cars to fly when hitting curbs

Improved the character's movement and friction

Reworked the car selection menu to fix issues with certain resolutions

Added a confirmation menu when starting a new career

Added extra safety checks to prevent accidentally loading into a corrupted save

Major improvements to loading times

Fixed sound reverb when driving in open areas

Fixed photo-mode camera sensitivity

Adjusted UI size for high resolutions & Improved cursor quality

Reworked the lift system (separate up & down movements with UI buttons with "steps")

Various bug fixes and improvements

Notes : 

The cheat code has been removed with the integration of the cheat menu since the cheat code seemed to be confusing for some players

This update has nothing to do with the Unreal Engine 5 progress and it won't slow it down as I am the unity version developer known as "Moh" aka "Impala67" and I am not on the UE5 team, I just tried to do something that hopefully you will like and help you enjoy the game a bit more till the release of the UE5 version  

A former member of the development team for the unity version known as "Amris" and myself are working on little content update for the next update that we hope you like, stay tuned! 

Feel free to suggest features/simple content for the current Unity version that you would like to see in upcoming updates and we will do our best to add them 


Hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Update V0.035 + Important announcement
notes.notes:
Changelog

 Added a laptop for the "EG6" 
 First person camera can now be moved via mouse (by pressing right click)
 Increased time attack payouts and increased its difficulty
 New automatic exposure method
 Fixed major memory leaks 
 Fixed a bug with turbo boost being too high on loading the game
 Fixed the disappearing BOV sounds 
 Increased aftermarket turbochargers' spool volume
 Fixed few naming/spelling mistakes
 Fixed inverted rims on "C35"
 Disabled saving outside the garage to prevent major bugs with steering axis
 Fixed the game starting on the wrong monitor for multi monitor setup


Notes: 

 A new save is highly recommended
 Saving and loading is only available in the garage
 USB Pedals and handbrakes are tested on the game


Important Announcement :
As you might know, the game is being remade from scratch in Unreal Engine 5 (UE5) due to issues with unity policies and limitations with unity game engine. It saddens us to lose years of progress, hard work, and experience. However, it is for the better for all of us to have a more polished game with better potential. As you might expect, making the whole game again from scratch in a new engine with a different programming language is very challenging and time consuming so it won't be done in a day, we are working daily on it progressing as fast as possible but also thinking ahead for the future to avoid future limitations like the ones we faced in the current unity version. 
We are progressing well on the remake but the majority of the team has decided to only show "finished" or "polished" content to avoid confusion, stay tuned for development updates! 

I would like to repeat again that the unreal version of Apex Point will be free for all the current players 

While the majority of the team is extremely focused on the remake, the updates frequency for the game will be reduced as you may have noticed. I will still provide small updates as much as possible to the amazing community we have and we hope you understand the situation.
I would like to thank the whole community for their help on making our dream come true and for their patience. Stay tuned for the remake of Apex Point and in the mean time we hope you enjoy the current version to the fullest!
